title: Extract a shared L1 pump helper to remove 8 duplicated ProviderScope/MaterialApp blocks in onboarding presentation tests
why: TQ-3 calls for a shared pumpApp helper; the only pumpApp in the repo is a method on the E2E harness class (test/e2e/harness/e2e_harness.dart:304), unusable for lightweight L1 widget tests. Every L1 file in this batch hand-rolls its own ProviderScope > MaterialApp(locale, 4 l10n delegates, supportedLocales) > Scaffold scaffold instead, and wizard_steps_l1_test.dart repeats the identical ~20-line block 5 times in the same file, one per step group. onboarding_steps_overflow_test.dart is the one file in this batch that does this correctly via the shared expectNoOverflowAcrossDevices/_wrap helper, proving the pattern is achievable. Any future change (new l10n delegate, new supportedLocales source) requires touching 8 call sites in this batch alone.
recommendation: Extract a shared, parameterized pump helper (e.g. test/helpers/pump_l1_widget.dart) taking a Widget-building function plus optional locale/overrides, matching overflow_harness.dart's _wrap shape; migrate these 8 sites onto it.
acceptance_criteria: a single shared L1 pump helper exists under test/helpers/ and all 8 call sites in this batch use it
